title: Arc solutions
description: A big left-aligned heading over full-width 320px panels with 20px corners: an illustration on the left, a pill badge, 30px title, paragraph and bold link on the right. The first panel is pale grey, the second dark slate. On phones the illustration sits on top. Each panel fades and rises 15px as it scrolls into view and dims slightly on hover.
notes: the inverse panel puts the `dark` class on itself and uses the theme's dark card colour
the reveal needs CSS scroll-driven animations; elsewhere the panels simply show
